image_description: A close-up view of a human forehead featuring a beige adhesive bandage (Band-Aid) applied horizontally. The bandage has a central white absorbent pad and textured adhesive wings. The skin shows fine details like pores and hair follicles, and dark hair is visible at the very top edge.

artifact_observations.location: Left edge of the bandage adhesive wing
artifact_observations.reasoning: The left edge of the bandage blends into the skin with a slight 'melting' or soft-focus effect, lacking the crisp shadow or edge definition expected from a physical object adhering to skin. It looks slightly painted on.
The right edge appears to fray or dissolve into the skin texture rather than having a clean cut edge, suggesting minor generation instability in the boundary definition.

To assess if the skin texture around the bandage is consistent or shows signs of AI smearing/hallucination.

Consistency of the fabric texture on the adhesive wings
